create_pdf_chat_export: create a PDF export from chat messages using PDFGenerator with a title and message list
generate_html_message: generate HTML markup for a single chat message with role, content, timestamp, and model
generate_html_body: generate the full HTML body for a PDF including escaped title and rendered messages
format_timestamp: format a UNIX timestamp into a readable date string in YYYY-MM-DD, HH:MM:SS format
build_pdf_from_chat: build a PDF document from chat form data containing title and messages using fpdf
